groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: something done with the hands.

chars.story: A hand passing one thing over and taking another back: switch, exchange.
chars.note: 换钱 'change money', 换衣服 'change clothes'.

chars.story: A hand sorting through the pile and picking one out: select.
chars.note: 擇: the right side 睪 shrank to 𠬤. Modern prose uses it mostly in 选择.

chars.story: A flat white palm 白 coming down: pat, clap.
chars.note: Mostly 'take a photo, shoot a film': 拍照, 拍电影.

chars.story: A hand pressed flat until everything is still 安: press.
chars.note: 按照 'according to' is its commonest use.

chars.story: Hands wrapped round what you use 用 and keep: hold close, embrace.
chars.note: 拥有 'possess' is its commonest word. 擁: 雍 became 用.

groups.title: war and crime
groups.note: Soldiers, fighting, and breaking the law.

chars.parts: 斤 axe + 丌 two hands
chars.story: Two hands 丌 holding up an axe 斤: a soldier.
Striking 攵 at the enemy's works 工, again and again: attack.
chars.note: Also 'study hard' (攻读).

chars.story: A body 身 drawing the bow back with one hand 寸: shoot.

chars.parts: - a ladle with a long handle
chars.story: Two men swinging a long-handled ladle at each other: fight.
chars.note: Two characters merged: 鬥 'fight' and 斗 'dipper' (北斗 'the Big Dipper').

chars.story: A hand thrust up high 亢 against the blow: resist.
chars.note: Also 'anti-': 抗日 'resist Japan'.

chars.story: Caught in the net 罒 for doing wrong 非: crime.
chars.note: Also 'guilt' and 'suffering' (受罪).

chars.parts: 犭 animal + 㔾 kneeling man
chars.story: An animal 犭 springing at a kneeling man 㔾: offend, break the law.
chars.note: Also 'commit' a mistake (犯错) and 'criminal' (犯人).

groups.title: buying and selling
groups.note: Money, goods and tickets.

chars.parts: 士 scholar + 示 altar + 欠 open mouth
chars.story: An offering laid on the altar 示, a mouth open 欠 asking for more: funds.
chars.note: Also 'clause' (条款) and 'model, style' (新款 'new model').

chars.story: Shells 贝 that hook 勾 the goods your way: purchase.
Money 贝 changed 化 into things: goods, commodities.
买 'buy' with an extra 十 on top: the other side of buying: sell.
chars.note: Tell it from 买 'buy' by the 十 on top. 賣 was 出 'out' over 買.

chars.story: Metal 钅 melted down small 肖, then sold off.
chars.note: Also 'cancel' (撤销). The old sense is 'melt metal'.

chars.story: A slip laid on the altar 示 under a cover 覀: your ticket in.
chars.note: Also 'ballot' (投票) and 'banknote'.

groups.title: places and travel
groups.note: Islands, towns, streets and halls.

chars.parts: 鸟 bird (without its feet) + 山 mountain
chars.story: A bird 鸟 perched on a mountain 山 out at sea: island.
chars.note: 島: 鳥 became 鸟, its feet replaced by 山.

chars.story: Three bends of a country road: the countryside, your home village.
chars.note: 鄉 lost its sides; only the left twist is left.

chars.parts: 行 crossroads + 圭 earth on earth
chars.story: Earth 土 packed on earth 土 between the two halves of 行 'go': a street.
Food 饣 for an official 官 on his travels: a guesthouse, now any public building.
chars.note: 大使馆 'embassy', 餐馆 'restaurant'.

chars.story: A lean-to 广 occupying 占 a corner of the street: a shop.
chars.note: 酒店 is a hotel in modern use.

chars.story: The open court 廷 under the palace eaves 广: a court.
chars.note: 家庭 'family, household' is its commonest word.

chars.story: Mounds 阝 of earth heaped up out of the sea: land.
chars.note: 大陆 is often 'mainland China'. Also the formal 'six' on cheques.

chars.parts: 方 flagpole + 𠂉 flag + 𧘇 people
chars.story: People marching behind a flag: a band on the move: travel.
chars.note: Also 'brigade' in the army.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: anything wet.

chars.story: The Han River 氵 named a dynasty, and the dynasty named the people: Chinese.
chars.note: Also 'man, fellow'. 漢: the right side became 又.

chars.story: The skin 皮 of the water 氵 rippling: wave.
chars.note: Also spells names: 波兰 Poland.

chars.story: Liquid 氵 pressed from 由 seeds: oil.
chars.note: 加油! 'Come on! Keep going!'

chars.parts: 氵 water + 白 white + 方 square + 攵 tap
chars.story: Water 氵 struck 攵 hard, white 白 spray flying: stirred up, excited.
chars.note: Also 'fierce, sharp': 激烈.

groups.title: metal 钅
groups.note: Metal on the left: metals, tools, coins.

chars.story: Metal 钅 that loses 失 its shine to rust: iron.
Metal 钅 with a hard, stubborn 艮 shine: silver.
A metal 钅 weight that holds things truly 真 in place: a garrison, a town.
chars.note: Also 'press down, calm' (镇静 'calm').

chars.story: A metal 钅 bell struck in the middle 中: bell, clock.
chars.note: 鐘 'bell' and 鍾 'cup' merged into 钟.

groups.title: silk 纟 糸
groups.note: Silk on the left 纟, or underneath 糸.

chars.parts: 〢 two strokes + 又 hand + 糸 silk
chars.story: A hand 又 pulling the silk thread 糸 hard: tight.
chars.note: Same top as 坚 'solid'.

chars.story: A silk 纟 thread, fine as the lines between fields 田: slender.
chars.note: Mostly 'fine, detailed': 详细, 细节, 仔细.

chars.story: Silk 纟 taken inside 内 as tribute: take in.
chars.note: Also spells foreign names: 纳粹 'Nazi'.

chars.parts: 龶 plant top + 糸 silk
chars.story: Raw silk 糸 hanging straight down: plain, the basic stuff: element.
chars.note: Also 'plain, vegetarian' (素食).

groups.title: grammar words
groups.note: Small words that hold sentences together.

chars.parts: - breath rising past a bar and fanning out
chars.story: Breath rising past a bar and fanning out: a little word tacked on.
chars.note: His Analects card: '?'. Modern 乎 lives only in fixed words: 几乎, 似乎, 在乎.

chars.story: Sweet 甘 things, a pair 匹 of them, more than you need: excessive.
chars.note: 甚至 'even, so far as' is its commonest word.

chars.story: A boat 舟 pushed with a pole 殳 this way and that: a way, a sort.
chars.note: Almost always in 一般 'ordinary, generally'.

chars.parts: - two hooks locked together between two lines
chars.story: Two hooks caught in each other between top and bottom: mutual.

groups.title: person 亻 人
groups.note: A person, on the left or on top.

chars.story: A person 亻 stopping at a roadside pavilion 亭: halt.
chars.note: 停车 'park a car'.

chars.story: A person 亻 standing by 以 another, the two looking alike: seem.
chars.note: Also 'be like' (似的 'as if').

chars.parts: 人 person + 丿丨 two pieces of armour
chars.story: A person 人 between two plates of armour, front and back: lie between.
chars.note: Almost always in 介绍 'introduce'.

groups.title: roof 宀
groups.note: A roof on top: a house.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 申 lay out (sound)
chars.story: Under the roof 宀, the case laid out 申 for a closer look: examine.
chars.note: 審: 番 under the roof became 申.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 畐 full jar
chars.story: A house 宀 with a full jar 畐: rich.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'wealth'. Modern 富 is mostly 'rich', and 丰富 'plentiful'.

chars.story: Jade 玉 kept under the roof 宀: treasure.
chars.note: 寶 also had 缶 and 贝 under the roof.

groups.title: sheep 羊
groups.note: Sheep on top 𦍌: good things, food, kindness.

chars.parts: 𦍌 sheep + strokes left of 食 food
chars.story: A sheep 羊 fed and kept: nurture animals and children.
chars.note: 養 had 食 food under the sheep.

chars.story: A sheep 羊 on top, a kind mouth 口 below: make good, improve.
chars.note: Also 'kind' (善良) and 'good at' (善于).

chars.parts: 𦍌 sheep + 丿 + 工 tool
chars.story: A sheep top slid askew over the carpenter's square 工: off by a little: a difference.
chars.note: Also 'poor, bad' (很差), 差点 'nearly', and 出差 'business trip'.

groups.title: earth 土
groups.note: Earth: the ground, walls, heaps.

chars.parts: 〢 two strokes + 又 hand + 土 earth
chars.story: A hand tamping the earth down hard: steadfast.
chars.note: Same top as 紧 'tight'.

chars.story: Earth that will not 不 hold: bad.
chars.note: Also 'broken' (坏了 'it's broken'). 壞: 褱 became 不.

chars.story: Earth 土 spread out even 匀: equal shares.

groups.title: flesh 月
groups.note: 月 here is flesh: parts of the body.

chars.parts: 月 flesh + 亠 lid + 凶 skull
chars.story: Flesh 月 under a lid 亠, inside the marked skull 凶: the brain.
chars.note: 电脑 'electric brain' is a computer.

chars.parts: 北 two men back to back + 月 flesh
chars.story: The flesh 月 where two men stand back to back 北: the back.
chars.note: Also 'carry on the back' (背包 'backpack') and 'learn by heart'.

chars.parts: 十 grass + 日 sun + 十 grass + 月 moon
chars.story: The sun 日 rising through the grass while the moon 月 still shows: morning court, a dynasty.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'morning'. Also 'towards' (朝着); 朝鲜 is Korea.

groups.title: numbers
groups.note: Eight, a thousand, a hundred million.

chars.story: Two strokes splitting apart: eight.
chars.note: As a part (分, 半) it means 'divide'.

chars.parts: - 十 ten with a stroke on top
chars.story: A slanting stroke laid over 十: a thousand.
chars.note: 千万 is also 'ten million'.

chars.story: A person 亻 beside one hook 乙 of tally marks, far more than he can count: a hundred million.
chars.note: Big numbers go by 万 (10,000) and 亿 (100,000,000).

groups.title: talk and learning
groups.note: Discussing, telling, explaining, knowing widely.

chars.story: Words measured out carefully, inch 寸 by inch: ask for something.
chars.note: 讨论 'discuss' is its commonest word; 讨厌 'dislike'.

chars.story: Walking 辶 others through a skill 术 step by step: narrate.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'pass on'. Modern 述 is 'state, narrate'.

chars.story: Sorting grains 釆 apart one by one: explain, set loose.
chars.note: Also 'release' (释放). 釋 and 擇 shrank the same way: 睪 became 𠬤.

chars.story: Ten 十 directions spread out 尃: broad and learned.
chars.note: Also 'gamble' (赌博).

groups.title: laughing and singing
groups.note: Fun: laughter, song, ha!

chars.story: Bamboo ⺮ bending 夭 in the wind like a man shaking with laughter: laugh.
chars.note: Also 'smile' and 'laugh at'.

chars.parts: 哥 elder brother (sound) + 欠 open mouth
chars.story: A mouth open wide 欠 beside 哥: sing a song.
A mouth 口 opening and closing 合: ha ha!
chars.note: An exclamation. It also spells names: 哈佛 Harvard.

groups.title: names from abroad
groups.note: Countries and foreign names.

chars.parts: 𠦝 sun among grass + 韦 leather
chars.story: Sunrise 𠦝 seen over a land fenced with leather 韦: the old state Han, now Korea.
chars.note: Also a surname and an ancient state. 韓: 韋 became 韦.

chars.story: A person 亻 with a halberd 我 on a frozen frontier: Russia.
chars.note: The old sense is 'suddenly' (俄顷).

chars.story: A person 亻 with a hand on the staff 尹: that person, he or she.
chars.note: Mostly spells foreign names: 伊朗 Iran, 伊拉克 Iraq. Lu Xun uses 伊 for 'she'.

groups.title: tree 木 and grain 禾
groups.note: A tree, or a grain stalk with a drooping head.

chars.story: The hard stone at the heart of a tree's 木 fruit: kernel, nucleus.
chars.note: Also 'check, verify' (核实, 审核).

chars.story: Every 佥 log 木 looked over one by one: check.
Many 多 rice seedlings 禾 moved to a new field: shift.

groups.title: sun 日
groups.note: The sun, above or inside.

chars.story: The sun 日 shining on the capital 京: a fine view: scenery.
Music 音 played through to the end 十: one piece, one chapter.
chars.note: Also 'seal, badge' (印章, 奖章).

chars.story: A woman 女 brought home at dusk 昏, when weddings were held: marry.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Pictures to learn as a whole.

chars.parts: - a jade pendant hanging from a belt
chars.story: A belt with a big jade pendant hanging: the yellow of old jade.
chars.note: 黄色 can also mean 'pornographic'. Also the surname Huang.

chars.story: A dragon rearing, tail flicked out, one scale for a dot.
chars.note: 龍 was far more complex; this is a shorthand.

chars.parts: - a person held back from behind
chars.story: A person held back by a stroke at his heel: he stays a long time.

chars.parts: - the old 臨 squeezed: 〢 on the left, a figure over things on the right
chars.story: A figure leaning over the things below, almost there: about to.
chars.note: Also 'face, overlook' (面临 'face').

groups.title: heart 心 忄
groups.note: The heart, on the left 忄 or underneath 心.

chars.story: A heart 忄 gone white 白: afraid.
chars.note: 恐怕 'probably, I'm afraid'. 哪怕 'even if'.

chars.story: 你 'you' with a heart 心 underneath: the polite you.
chars.note: No other word uses it: it is 你 for elders, customers, strangers.

groups.title: up and down
groups.note: Rising and coming down.

chars.story: A grain measure lifted high: rise, ascend.
chars.note: 昇 'rise' and 陞 'promote' merged into it. Also 'litre'.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 夂 foot + 㐄 foot
chars.story: Two feet 夂 㐄 stepping down a hillside 阝: descend.
chars.note: Also 'surrender' (投降).

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants.

chars.story: Herbs 艹 tied up 约 in bundles: drugs, medicine.
chars.note: 藥: 樂 under the grass became 约.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 者 one who
chars.story: One who 者 stands out like grass 艹 shooting up: outstanding.
chars.note: Lookalike 着 has a sheep top. 著作 'a book, written work'.

groups.title: dish 皿
groups.note: A dish or basin underneath.

chars.parts: 水 water lying on its side + 皿 dish
chars.story: Water heaped above the rim of a dish 皿: more than enough: benefit.

chars.parts: 皿 dish + 丿 a drop
chars.story: A drop 丿 falling into the offering dish 皿: blood.

groups.title: tap 攵
groups.note: 攵 on the right is a hand with a stick: tap, strike, act.

chars.story: Beating 攵 off the attackers to answer someone's plea 求: rescue.
chars.note: 救命! 'Help!'

chars.parts: 彳 step + 山 mountain + 几 small figure + 攵 tap
chars.story: Stepping 彳 softly past a tiny figure 几 under the hill 山: tiny.

groups.title: lid 亠
groups.note: A lid 亠 on top.

chars.parts: 亠 lid + 厶 child + 儿 legs
chars.story: A child growing under a lid 亠 on its legs 儿 until it fills the space: fill.
chars.note: Also 'act as' (充当).

chars.parts: 亠 lid + 口 mouth + 子 child
chars.story: A child 子 at the table 口 under the temple roof 亠: enjoy the offering.

groups.title: knife 刂
groups.note: A knife on the right.

chars.parts: 畐 full jar + 刂 knife
chars.story: A full jar 畐 cut 刂 in two: the second half, the deputy.
chars.note: Also a measure word for pairs and sets: 一副眼镜 'a pair of glasses'.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 刂 knife + 王 jade
chars.story: A knife 刂 splitting jade 王 into two equal halves: a group divided up: class, shift.
chars.note: 上班 and 下班 'go to work, leave work'.

groups.title: big 大
groups.note: A man with arms out: big.

chars.story: A big 大 man who can 可 stand on one leg: odd, wonderful.
chars.note: Also 'wonderful' (奇迹 'miracle').

chars.parts: - 大 a man with a yoke 冂 across his neck
chars.story: A man 大 with a yoke across his shoulders, right in the middle: center.
chars.note: Almost always in 中央.

groups.title: spear 戈
groups.note: 戈 is a dagger-axe.

chars.story: A halberd 戌 held over a woman 女: power, might.
A cart 车 heaped with weapons 戈: load.
chars.note: Also 'record, publish' (记载 'record').

groups.title: wine jar 酉
groups.note: 酉 is a wine jar.

chars.parts: 酉 wine jar + 己 self
chars.story: A man 己 kneeling by the wine jar 酉, mixing it just right: match.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 酉 wine jar
chars.story: Liquid 氵 from the wine jar 酉: alcohol.
chars.note: Any alcohol: 啤酒 'beer', 葡萄酒 'wine'.

sentences.en: What time do you go to work?
He's at the bank exchanging money.
I am staying at the hotel for the time being.
The town was full of activity.
This medicine has no side effects.
I hardly ever go to museums.

sentences.zh: 哈利波特的新片十分差。
sentences.en: The new Harry Potter movie is pretty lame.

sentences.zh: 加拿大的犯罪率下降了。
票不到一个钟头就卖得精光。
sentences.en: All the tickets sold out in an hour.
